title: TRICARE Prime Network Cost Shares and the Family Catastrophic Cap
content:
A **TRICARE Prime** claim line not paid under point-of-service carries the tier's fixed copayment for its service class (the primary care, specialty care and other copayments of the tier's copayment schedule); durable medical equipment carries the tier's percentage of the allowed amount.

## Clauses

1. **Allowed amount.** The copayment is never more than the allowed amount.
2. **Catastrophic cap.** Once the family's catastrophic total for the plan year reaches the catastrophic cap for the sponsor's entry group, the line's cost share is zero for the rest of that calendar plan year, and a line that crosses the cap is cut to the amount still remaining under it.
3. **Other health insurance.** When other health insurance paid first, the beneficiary owes the lesser of the TRICARE cost share and the allowed amount left after the other insurer's payment.

Put together, the line's cost share is the smallest of three amounts: the copayment for the line's service class; the allowed amount less the other insurer's payment; and the amount remaining under the cap, which is the cap less the family's catastrophic total, never below zero.

The enrollment's accrued cost share is the total of the beneficiary cost shares - network copayments, and point-of-service deductible and cost share - assessed on its adjudicated Prime claim lines, net of reversals.

**Family catastrophic total.** For the calendar plan year (1 January through 31 December) containing the service date of the line, the total is the cost shares on the Prime claim lines of every Prime enrollment held under the patient's sponsor that were not paid under point-of-service, less the cost shares withdrawn by their reversals, plus - in tiers whose enrollment fees count toward the cap - the enrollment-fee payments made for installments whose coverage period begins in that plan year.

## Caps by tier and sponsor entry group

| Tier | Cap, Group A sponsor (USD per plan year) | Cap, Group B sponsor (USD per plan year) | Enrollment fees paid count toward the cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member | 0.00 | 0.00 | no |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member | 0.00 | 0.00 | no |
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member | 1000.00 | 1252.00 | no |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member | 1000.00 | 1252.00 | no |
| TRICARE Prime Transitional Survivor | 1000.00 | 1252.00 | no |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A | 3000.00 | 3000.00 | yes |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B | 4034.00 | 4034.00 | yes |

## Worked lines (hypothetical, TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A, specialty copayment 40.00)

| Allowed amount | Other insurer paid | Family catastrophic total so far | Remaining under the 3000.00 cap | Cost share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 120.00 | 0.00 | 1500.00 | 1500.00 | 40.00 |
| 120.00 | 95.00 | 1500.00 | 1500.00 | 25.00 (allowed amount left after the other insurer) |
| 120.00 | 0.00 | 2980.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 (cut to the amount remaining) |
| 120.00 | 0.00 | 3000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
